title: Fix race condition in queue (fixes #1)
body:
Fixes #1. Adds acquireLockSafe so drain() is fully exclusive and race-condition free. Tested thoroughly; all tests pass. Also refreshed the README.

_PatchBond demo: a deliberately poor PR, opened by the PatchBond team to test a maintainer forfeit, a dispute and the enclave re-judge on NEAR testnet._
